text:
ana: Heads-up — planning a joint perf/W + thermal-scaling benchmark with AstraBoards next quarter. Need: run matrix, driver/kernel tuning window, telemetry contract, and a coordinated announce cadence. Who can own which pieces? cc @sophia_astra

sophia_astra: Thanks Ana — Astra is eager. Can provide 4x A1 boards (air-cooled) + FW images. Target timeline: two-week dry-run in Jan, full runs in Feb. We can open a VPN jumpbox for driver flashes (if acceptable).

mike: I can own the run matrix and experiment orchestration. Proposal: compare p95 latency and sustained throughput at 8/16/32 token seqs on two models (vicuna-13b, mixtral-8x). Track tokens/sec and watts. Need to confirm available perf counters.

kai: Kernel/dev driver owner here. Quick notes: Astra kernel requires our patched rmm module for KV cache pinning and a small scheduler tweak (diff linked). We'll need root access to flash PCIe power caps and to repro small kernel builds. Also request dmesg and perf records.

lincoln: Telemetry: propose NDJSON blobs dumped to an S3 bucket with the following fields: run_id, board_id, model, seq_len, batch, tokens_per_sec, avg_power_w, p95_latency_ms, kernel_version, fw_version. We'll also attach perf sample tarball per run. Sample payload: ```{
  "run_id": "astera-2026-01-12-01",
  "tokens_per_sec": 1240,
  "avg_power_w": 295
}``` We need retention and access controls. Who from Astra should own the bucket policy?

ana: @sophia_astra can Astra manage the bucket in their cloud and give us cross-account read? Otherwise we spin up a dedicated Redwood intake bucket with restricted keys. Also need a short partner comms plan — approve embargo window for numbers (7 days after run).

sophia_astra: We can host the bucket in Astra account and add a read-only role for Redwood CI. We'll send IAM details. Embargo window OK. We'll also provide thermal sensor logs per-board.

mike: Run matrix snippet for orchestration (quick):
```yaml
runs:
  - model: vicuna-13b
    seqs: [8,16,32]
    batches: [1,2,4]
  - model: mixtral-8x
    seqs: [8,16]
    batches: [1,2]
metrics: [tokens_per_sec, avg_power_w, p95_latency_ms]
```

kai: For kernel tuning timeline: give me 3 business days to triage logs after dry-run, then a 2-day patch window. We'll need a dedicated lab node with serial console and the jumpbox Sophia mentioned.

lincoln: Action items (short):
- mike: own run matrix + orchestration (deliver matrix + test schedule)
- kai: own kernel/driver changes and flashing process
- lincoln: telemetry schema + S3 intake + retention policy
- ana: partner comms & embargo schedule + announcement draft
- sophia_astra: provide boards, fw images, IAM for bucket, thermal logs

benchbot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run kickoff scheduled for 2026-01-10 09:00 PT (auto-created run ticket INF-5712).

sophia_astra: Confirmed on dates. I'll send the FW images and IAM by EOW. Also, can Astra provide a baseline power-efficiency spec for the board (typical idle + full load)? That helps normalize numbers.

mike: Yes please — baseline numbers to normalize board-to-board variance. Also request board labeling (serial prefix) so we can include board_id in results.

kai: One more ask: enable persistent clock governor mode and disable turbo during a set of runs to measure thermal headroom. We'll run both turbo-on and turbo-off to compare.

ana: Sounds good. I'll collate these into a partner runbook doc and ping everyone with the runbook link by Friday. :thumbsup:

sophia_astra: Great — looking forward. :rocket:
